comments.cwd: Every script `cd ..` first so the tool runs with the repository root as CWD. This is load-bearing for markdownlint: run from tools/, it resolves .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc relative to tools/, silently ignores the root config, and lints the gitignored .matan/ and .pi-subagents/ scratch directories (28 files instead of 3).
comments.versions: markdownlint-cli2 has no advisory-free release in either direction: >=0.23 depends on js-yaml 5.x (GHSA-pm4m-ph32-ghv5, flow-collection parsing DoS) and <=0.22 depends on js-yaml 4.x (GHSA-mh29-5h37-fv8m prototype pollution) plus a ReDoS-affected markdown-it. Newest is chosen because all of these are denial-of-service/pollution issues in parsing UNTRUSTED YAML, and this is a dev-only CLI that only ever parses this repository's own markdown and config. `npm audit` is therefore not run in CI; it would be permanently red for a risk that is not reachable here.
